newsitem.title: UK: Smith & Nephew says no change in trading.
newsitem.headline: Smith & Nephew says no change in trading.

text.p: Healthcare group Smith & Nephew Plc said on Monday that trading in all regions had continued in line with indications given in October, when it said that operating conditions remained difficult.

In a statement following a briefing to analysts, Smith & Nephew said "current trading of the group in all its regions has continued much in line with the prior indications given at the group's presentation to analysts and institutional shareholders in October."
Shares showed little reaction to the brief statement, and were trading up 1/4 pence at 178 pence at 1110 GMT.

On October 14 the company said overall sales growth in the second half of 1996 was continuing in line with the six months to the end of June, when turnover rose 7.4 percent to 540 million stg. However, it said it was trading in difficult market conditions.
